producer_report.summary:
I rebuilt each card on decisions.html. The card leads with one yes/no question, an 'If yes' line, an 'If no' line, a 'Cost and risk' line and a 'Who decides' line. The rung, raising role, source, evidence and record link now sit in a closed 'Evidence and record' details block. I ran `cargo test -p xtask` (all pass, including the policy scan) and clippy on xtask. I did not run `cargo test --workspace`.

Root cause: a proposal record holds only a title, rung, source and evidence. The old card showed those fields raw, and the first retry rewrote the same fixed text onto every card. Cards now use only those fields:
- **Verb titles:** A title that starts with a verb is treated as the change itself. The question and both outcome lines are built around it and around what its rung changes, so they differ per proposal.
- **Other titles:** The card says plainly that the record states a problem, not a change. It asks whether to start work on the problem, rather than faking a change.
- **Cost and risk:** The line says 'not recorded' and adds only what the rung reaches and how many files, earlier tasks and saved changes back the proposal.
- **Recommendations:** No card recommends, because no record holds one.
- **Who decides:** Above the role's limit, or for a role with no recorded definition, the line says 'you must decide'. Within the limit it says Athena may change it itself.
- **Internal words:** Titles are reworded to plain words first. For example, job becomes task and commit becomes saved change. `Brief::check` then refuses a card with an internal word above the details. It also refuses a card without exactly one question, without a 'Who decides:' line, or over the word limit. MAX_WORDS is now 170, up from 120.

I added a small CSS rule for the details summary in `site.rs`, and updated `owner-style.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`. The tests cover the four behavior criteria.

checks_run.note: 65 unit tests plus ci_shards, fingerprint, policy (boundary scan), site_page, spec and walltime all pass

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a test builds cards from at least two realistic Steward-shaped WorkItems (different title, rung, source, evidence count) and asserts the question lines differ, the 'If yes' lines differ, the 'If no' lines differ, each contains a fact from its own proposal, and no question equals the title with a fixed prefix.
criteria_check.evidence: Test question_and_both_outcomes_differ_per_proposal_and_use_its_own_facts uses three fixtures with different title, rung, source and evidence count. It passed in `cargo test -p xtask`. It asserts question, yes, no and cost differ pairwise and that each carries its own title words, area and evidence counts. It also asserts no question equals a fixed prefix plus the title, or ends with the title.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a test asserts a proposal above the raising role's limit renders 'you must decide' and the text 'Recommend no' appears on no card; a proposal with no recorded recommendation renders none.
criteria_check.evidence: Test above_the_limit_the_owner_must_decide_and_no_card_recommends passed. It checks 'you must decide' for the above-limit and unknown-role cases. It checks that the card HTML of every case (within the limit, above it, unknown role, newest role version) contains no 'recommend' at all.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a test asserts the byte offsets of the question (ending '?'), 'If yes', 'If no' and cost/risk lines are all smaller than the first evidence path, record id or record link, and that these sit inside a `<details>` element without `open`.
criteria_check.evidence: Test the_decision_comes_first_and_the_evidence_sits_in_a_closed_details_block passed. It compares offsets for two fixtures: the question, yes, no, cost and owner lines come before the Rung, Raised by, Source and Evidence lines, the evidence values, the record id and href. The evidence sits between <details> and </details>, and the HTML has no '<details open'.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a test renders a sample page and checks each card's visible words are within MAX_WORDS, it has exactly one question, and Brief::check refuses a card whose visible text contains banned jargon, including from a real-looking title.
criteria_check.evidence: Test a_page_of_cards_stays_short_has_one_question_each_and_refuses_internal_words renders a 5-card page, including titles full of jargon. It checks the word count, one '?' per card and no internal word above the details. Test a_card_that_holds_an_internal_word_is_refused shows Brief::check refuses jargon in each top line, and that a real-looking jargon title is reworded to plain words. Both passed.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` and `cargo test --workspace`: all pass, including existing xtask site tests that read decisions.html.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran `cargo fmt --all`, then `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` (clean) and `cargo test -p xtask` (all pass, including the site tests). I did not run the workspace suite.

criteria_check.criterion: Grep xtask/src/decisions.rs: 'Rung:', 'Raised by:', 'Source:' appear only inside the details section, and the module doc describes the new layout; CHANGELOG.md has an entry and docs/conventions/owner-style.md matches the behavior.
criteria_check.evidence: In html(), the three lines are written only after the <details> opener, and the test asserts each occurs once and after the owner line. The module doc was rewritten for the new layout. The CHANGELOG entry and the owner-style rules and mechanism text were rewritten to match.

criteria_check.criterion: The diff touches no file under records/, crates/, athena.toml, defaults.toml or .github/workflows.
criteria_check.evidence: Edited files: xtask/src/decisions.rs, xtask/src/site.rs, docs/conventions/owner-style.md, CHANGELOG.md. Nothing else was edited.

open_issues: Real fix for unclear cards: add question, outcome, cost and recommendation fields to the work item record, filled in by the Steward. That is out of scope here, because it touches crates/.

A title that begins with a verb is read as the change itself, based on a fixed verb list in decisions.rs. Titles that start with another verb are shown as a problem statement, which is honest but less helpful. Extend the VERBS list as real titles show gaps.
MAX_WORDS rose from 120 to 170 to fit the new decision lines. The owner-style doc and changelog say 170.
The jargon rewording is word-for-word (job becomes task, commit becomes saved change). It can read awkwardly on real titles, for example 'Helper task'.
mistakes: In the first draft the cost line said 'Evidence:' before the details block, which would have broken the offset test. I renamed it 'Backed by:'.
learnings: A proposal record has only title, rung, source and evidence. Any per-card question, outcome or cost beyond that has to be derived from them.
Brief::check now scans only the text above the details block for internal words, because the details legitimately show rung names, role names and 'path' or 'job' labels.
The Bash hook rejects grep and tail; use the Grep and Read tools instead.
